tools.name: codex_run
tools.title: Run a task with the local Codex CLI
tools.description: Hand a natural-language task to the local Codex CLI coding agent. Codex can write and run code, install packages and call APIs inside an isolated workspace folder, then this returns its output plus any files it created. If Codex takes longer than wait_sec, this returns status: running and a job_id instead; call codex_job_result with it to collect the result.

prompt.description: The task for Codex, written as you would to a developer.

workspace.description: Relative workspace folder name under the workspace root. Reuse the same name to continue working on the same files. Defaults to a new timestamped folder.

timeout_sec.description: Seconds before Codex is killed. Default 300.

model.description: Override the Codex model for this run.

reasoning_effort.description: Model reasoning effort. Supported values depend on the model.

wait_sec.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id instead. Default 45, maximum 50, which keeps the call under common 60-second client timeouts.

tools.name: codex_generate_image
tools.title: Generate images via the local Codex CLI
tools.description: Generate images with the local Codex CLI. The prompt is passed through as written. Returns the saved file paths and shows the images inline, downscaling a preview when a file is too large to inline. Defaults to a fast low-quality 1024x1024 draft; raise quality for final assets. Image generation often takes longer than wait_sec, in which case this returns status: running and a job_id; call codex_job_result with it to collect the images.

size.description: Pixel size as WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. "1024x1024" (fastest, the default), "1536x1024" landscape, "1024x1536" portrait, or "auto". This is a request to Codex; the actual dimensions are reported in the result.

quality.description: Generation quality. Default "low" - fastest, good for drafts. Use "high" for final assets.

model.description: Override the Codex model for this image task.

reasoning_effort.description: Codex reasoning effort, subject to model support.

output_format.description: Requested saved format. Default JPEG for smaller opaque images.

output_compression.description: Requested JPEG or WebP output quality, 1 to 100. Default 80. PNG is lossless.

background.description: Requested image background. Use PNG or WebP for transparency.

target_file_kb.description: Target KB per image, default 256. A prompt preference; actual size is reported.

workspace.description: Workspace folder name. Defaults to a new folder.

open.description: Open the generated images in the user's default image viewer. Default true, because MCP clients do not render tool-result images into the chat.

wait_sec.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id instead. Default 45, maximum 50, which keeps the call under common 60-second client timeouts.

tools.name: codex_job_result
tools.title: Collect the result of a running Codex job
tools.description: Get the result of a codex_run or codex_generate_image call that returned status: running. Waits up to wait_sec for the job to finish; if it is still running, call again. Results stay available for 60 minutes after the job finishes.

job_id.description: The job_id returned by codex_run or codex_generate_image.

wait_sec.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id instead. Default 45, maximum 50, which keeps the call under common 60-second client timeouts.

tools.name: codex_read_artifact
tools.title: Read a file produced by Codex
tools.description: Read one file from a Codex workspace, for artifacts that were too large to inline. Images come back as image content, everything else as text.

path.description: Path to the file, relative to the workspace root or absolute inside it.

max_bytes.description: Refuse files larger than this. Default 5000000.

tools.name: codex_projects
tools.title: List the local projects codex_task can work on
tools.description: List the git projects configured on this computer for codex_task, with the check names each one defines and whether it has a setup command. Local paths are not shown.

tools.name: codex_task
tools.title: Delegate a coding task on a local git project to Codex
tools.description: Have the local Codex CLI work on a configured git project (see codex_projects). Push your branch first: the server fetches `ref` from the project's origin into a fresh worktree of the local clone, Codex works there inside its sandbox, and the result is Codex's final message plus a git patch against the `base:` commit, to apply with `git apply`. Nothing is pushed. If Codex takes longer than wait_sec, this returns status: running and a job_id; call codex_job_result with it to collect the result.

task.description: The task for Codex, written as you would to a developer. Passed through as written.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit to fetch from the project's origin and work on.

mode.description: "edit" (default) changes files and returns a patch; "review" is read-only and returns no patch.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria, appended to the task under a "Done when:" line.

checks.description: Names of the project's configured checks for Codex to run before finishing. Codex runs them inside its sandbox and reports the results; they are not independently verified.

return.description: "patch" (default) inlines the patch when small enough; "summary" only links it.

model.description: Override the Codex model for this task.

reasoning_effort.description: Model reasoning effort. Supported values depend on the model.

timeout_sec.description: Seconds before Codex is killed. Default 300.

wait_sec.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a job_id instead. Default 45, maximum 50, which keeps the call under common 60-second client timeouts.

resourceTemplates.name: workspace-file
resourceTemplates.title: Codex workspace file
resourceTemplates.description: A file produced by Codex inside the workspace root. Reads outside the root are refused.
